page.overview:
What is Springfield Elementary?

Senior Management: State Comptroller AtkinsGary ChalmersPrincipal:Seymour SkinnerFormer Principals:Ned Flanders (temporary)Seymour Skinner (real) (temporary)Bart Simpson (temporary)Meredith MilgramMelanie Upfoot ("Girls Just Want to Have Sums" only)Principal Hartly

Springfield Elementary School is an elementary school that Bart Simpson, Lisa Simpson, and many other children of Springfield, such as Nelson Muntz, Janey Powell, Sherri and Terri. Jimbo Jones, Martin Prince, Ralph Wiggum, and Milhouse Van Houten attend.

It is managed by Principal Seymour Skinner, who is overseen by district superintendent is Gary Chalmers, who often visits the school for routine inspections that go disastrously awry. The school's mascot is a purple puma, of which there is a statue inside the school. The school's address is 19 Plympton Street, Springfield, USA. although its address is also believed to be Bart Boulevard.

According to Superintendent Chalmers Springfield Elementary was "once classified the most dilapidated [school] in all of Missouri." It was then shut down, transported to Springfield, and rebuilt brick by brick.

Also known as: Springfield Elementary School.
